listing.name: 2Xtreme — 2Xtreme-recomp (catsandsoup)
listing.summary: Research project. Early preview. First disc check/preparation/intro and keyboard pause-menu work; controller verification, fullspeed/settings/widescreen, original Options binding, rumble/player2/savestates and notarization remain future work. No full playthrough or Portcove runtime qualification. Original files and setup are described below. Portcove has not verified setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Own USA SCUS-94508 disc image. App copies disc into private ApplicationSupport/2Xtreme/disc and generates local native game code on first launch; bundled MIT OpenBIOS, no retailBIOS required.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Advertised early-preview2Xtreme.zip ->2Xtreme.app. User imports own USA CUE/BIN, first launch builds locally in about15seconds according to upstream. App not notarized; no Xcode/Homebrew/Python required for player kit. Source make_app.sh additionally needs Apple tools/Homebrew/pinned Zig. No package downloaded or verified.

warnings: Early preview. First disc check/preparation/intro and keyboard pause-menu work; controller verification, fullspeed/settings/widescreen, original Options binding, rumble/player2/savestates and notarization remain future work. No full playthrough or Portcove runtime qualification.
